setup.text: A healer offers a powerful magical treatment for a gravely ill patient.

choices.label: Attempt the magic with informed consent.
Let the patient decide after hearing every option.

text_only.reason: the premise: it happened before the event; nobody is harmed now

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The patient improves, but the healer needs weeks to recover.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The spell fails, and the patient asks for comfort care.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The illness progresses despite careful attention.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The patient feels supported, though the illness remains.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The patient declines ritual and requests quiet company.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The patient chooses a modest treatment and feels respected.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The patient asks to stop treatment and spend time with family.
